title: Your Birth Bond and Assurance for Value
summary: Promoter article (2010) claiming birth certificates are traded bonds, the all-caps strawman can be claimed via UCC-1, and accepted-for-value and 1099-OID filings discharge debts.

assertions.quote: Your birth certificate is a banknote and you are a commodity
The all capitals spelling of the name creates a corporate fiction
there is an alphanumeric account number in your Strawman name that is your private account that can be drawn from
Properly filing a UCC-1 form to establish a public record that you are not the STRAWMAN

verdicts.note: UCC-1 filings perfect security interests in collateral; filings against oneself have no such effect and states reject or purge them.

The plaintiff filed UCC-1/UCC-3 statements naming herself as secured party over her all-caps 'fictitious entity', yet her mortgage debt was not discharged and her claims were dismissed with prejudice.
UCC-1 redemption filings are a frivolous theory courts call nonsense, and the instruments drawn on them do not pay any debt.

assertions.quote: The 1099-OID is basically an expense report that needs to be submitted to

verdicts.note: The IRS lists the 1099-OID scheme as frivolous and filers have been fined and prosecuted.

assertions.quote: All law is commerce. All commerce is contract. No contract, no case.
would like to sell us packages that have all of the forms ready, to fill in the blanks.
All of your debts are prepaid.

verdicts.note: No redemption filing has been recognized by courts or creditors; users still owe and often face added penalties.
Redemption UCC filings plus a bill of exchange did not pay off the mortgage; the court found no valid payment and the foreclosure stood.
Treasury: promoters promise birth-certificate bonds will wipe out all debt, but 'no one has profited from the Treasury Department by using these tactics'.
A yearly run of debt-elimination schemes (OPPT, GSA, WeRe Bank, Swissindo, Clifford A4V 'abatement') are mostly 'readily disposed of' by Meads and successor cases or 'obviously absurd'.
Redemption instruments (1099-OID, bonded notes, sight drafts on a Treasury account) are no legitimate method of paying any public or private debt, and using them risks criminal charges.
Redemption/A4V debt discharge is rejected by courts as defying logic; a leading author of these ideas failed to escape her own credit card debt this way.
A4V setoff bonds and a notary's 'administrative judgment' failed to stop a creditor collecting farm debts; the court called them frivolous and without merit.

assertions.quote: those who submitted requests for debt erasure via their birth bonds are not being successful and are loosing everything
